name: lt_complex
comment: Ordering operators (< > <= >=) on complex operands compare REAL parts only, imaginary ignored (MATLAB R2025b verified: (0+1i)<2=1, 2<(0+1i)=0, (3+4i)<(1+0i)=0); EQ/NE keep full complex equality. Covers scalar-scalar both orders, elementwise vectors, all four orderings + eq/ne. Found via fieldtest AHP.m (bugs/closed/lang/complex-relational-ops.md).
